summary: Man in his mid-60s injured in an ATV accident on Blue Creek Road around 11:55 a.m.; Upper San Juan Search and Rescue with Pagosa EMS reached him by six-wheel-drive UTV over rough trail, and as his pain worsened a Flight for Life helicopter flew him to Mercy Regional Medical Center; suspected broken wrist and ribs.
location: Blue Creek Road, Pagosa Springs area
responding_agency: Upper San Juan Search and Rescue; Pagosa EMS; Flight for Life
notes: INSERTED run 989 (Pagosa SUN chunk): Pagosa Springs SUN Sept 1, 2016 issue, "Rescue follows ATV accident" (p. A9), parent-opened live; Sunday-verified.
